lines.en: label dormwar17:
scene warsend1
: Rise and shine, maggots! We might not have[school] today, and the war might be over, but don’t think for a second that means you can rest!
lines.zh: : 起床啦，蛆虫们！今天我们虽然不用去[school]，战争也结束了，但你们别以为这就意味着可以休息！

lines.en: : You can rest. And you’re all free to leave as soon as our announcement is over.
lines.zh: : 你们可以休息。等宣布结果一结束，你们就都可以走了。

lines.en: : In fact, I should probably take roll call since it looks like we’re missing a few of...
lines.zh: : 其实，我大概该点个名，因为看起来我们少了几个……

lines.en: scene warsend2
: Wait, why are the only girls missing from my floor?
lines.zh: : 等等，为什么缺席的只有我这一层的女生？

lines.en: : Where is Ayane? And Maya? And Yu-
lines.zh: : Ayane 呢？Maya 呢？还有 Yu——

lines.en: : Well, I understand why Yumi is missing, so disregard that part please.
lines.zh: : 嗯，Yumi 为什么没来我懂，那部分请当我没说。

lines.en: scene warsend3
: Maya’s still recovering from the test of courage and Ayane wasn’t feeling well this morning.
lines.zh: : Maya 还在从试胆大会里缓过来，Ayane 今早不太舒服。

lines.en: : But I can probably get them to watch on Facetime if-
lines.zh: : 不过我大概可以让她们用 Facetime 看直播，如果——

lines.en: : Facetime?! More like {i}no{/i} time! We’ve gotta get this show on the road, Ami!
lines.zh: : Facetime？！不如说是{i}没{/i}时间！我们得赶紧把这场秀办起来，Ami！

lines.en: : Well...yes. I understand that. But they’re members of our team and-
lines.zh: : 嗯……好吧。我明白。可她们是我们队伍的成员，而且——

lines.en: : Just...recap them after the announcements are over, Ami. It appears that {i}certain{/i} people would like to make the most of their day off from[school]...
lines.zh: : 等宣布结果结束之后再给她们补上就好，Ami。看来{i}有些{/i}人想好好利用这难得的不用去[school]的一天……

lines.en: scene warsend4
: You talkin’ about me, Makoto?
lines.zh: : 你是在说我吗，Makoto？

lines.en: : {i}You?{/i} Noooo. Why ever would I do that?
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}？不是————。我怎么会那么做呢？

lines.en: : You wanna throw hands? Cause I’m ready to go right now.
lines.zh: : 你想动手？因为我现在就准备好了。

lines.en: : Throw...what?
lines.zh: : 动……什么？

lines.en: : Did you even sleep last night? You seem incredibly hyper for even your standards.
lines.zh: : 你昨晚到底睡没睡？就算按你的标准来看，你也亢奋得离谱。

lines.en: : Not even a little! I’m gonna spend the whole day under the covers and there ain’t anything you can do to stop me!
lines.zh: : 一秒都没睡！我今天要一整天都窝在被子里，你拿我没办法！

lines.en: : So, the results.
lines.zh: : 那么，结果。

lines.en: scene warsend5
: Right! Results!
lines.zh: : 对！结果！

lines.en: if ayanelust15 == True or futabalust15 == True or chikalust15 == True:
: So, if you’ve been keepin’ track of the normal score and your team is losing, don’t fret just yet! Cause we’ve got a bit of a surprise for you!
lines.zh: : 那么，如果你一直在跟进常规比分、而你的队伍正在落后，先别慌！因为我们给大家准备了一点惊喜！

lines.en: : We...certainly do, as it appears that some of our classmates have taken it upon themselves to conduct their own “bonus” competitions with Sensei as the judge.
lines.zh: : 我们……确实准备了，因为似乎有部分同学擅自拿主意，以老师为评委举办了她们自己的“额外”比赛。

lines.en: : I can only fathom what that must possibly mean.
lines.zh: : 我只能想象那到底意味着什么。

lines.en: scene warsend6
: The heck is a “bonus competition?!” I didn’t sign off on this!
lines.zh: : “额外比赛”到底是个什么鬼？！我可没批准过！

lines.en: : We were allowed to have our own competitions and no one told me?!
lines.zh: : 我们可以自己办比赛，居然没人告诉我？！

lines.en: : I demand we do the entire contest over! And I also demand to be included in the date war this time!
lines.zh: : 我要求整场比赛重来！另外我要求这次也把约会大战算进去！

lines.en: : I am in agreement with Noriko!
lines.zh: : 我同意 Noriko！

lines.en: : Who would have even had a bonus competition like that?!
lines.zh: : 到底谁会搞那种“额外比赛”啊？！

lines.en: scene warsend7
: Heheheh...
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿嘿……

lines.en: : Nodoka...
lines.zh: : Nodoka……

lines.en: : {i}Who{/i} indeed, Futaba. Who indeed...
lines.zh: : 是{i}谁{/i}呢，Futaba。是谁呢……

lines.en: : I would very much appreciate it if you would purge that night from your memory.
lines.zh: : 我非常希望你能把那一夜从记忆里抹掉。

lines.en: : Is this Eternal Sunshine all of a sudden? I can not simply conduct targeted purges of certain aspects of my memory, Futaba. Let alone the ones I cherish most.
lines.zh: : 这该不会是《暖暖内含光》吧？我可没法对记忆的某些部分进行定向清除，Futaba。更别提那些我最珍视的部分了。

lines.en: : Please don’t consider that one of your most precious memories, either.
lines.zh: : 那也别把它当成你最珍贵的回忆之一吧。

lines.en: : Was it not as enjoyable for you as it was for me?
lines.zh: : 难道你不像我一样享受吗？

lines.en: : It...wasn’t {i}not{/i} enjoyable, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我……大概也不算{i}不{/i}享受吧。

lines.en: : Is this an invitation for further {i}contests{/i} in the future?
lines.zh: : 这是在邀请我以后继续{i}比赛{/i}吗？

lines.en: : We should...probably listen to the results.
lines.zh: : 我们……还是听结果吧。

lines.en: scene warsend5
: Doesn’t matter who it was! All that matters is that it happened!
lines.zh: : 是谁不重要！重要的是它确实发生了！

lines.en: : And for the safety of those involved, we have decided not to reveal any names!
lines.zh: : 而且为了当事人的安全，我们决定不公布任何名字！

lines.en: : Reveal the names!
lines.zh: : 把名字公布出来！

lines.en: : Oust the betrayers!
lines.zh: : 把叛徒揪出来！

lines.en: : Silence!
lines.zh: : 肃静！

lines.en: scene warsend8
: The Super Mega Ultimate Dorm War has finally reached its end.
lines.zh: : 超级无敌究极宿舍大战终于走到了终点。

lines.en: : And the first ever winners are...
lines.zh: : 而史上第一支获胜队伍是……

lines.en: else:
: So, we had a pretty standard ten match brawl. No bonus points awarded. No secret contests. Nothing like that.
lines.zh: : 那么，我们打了很标准的十场混战。没有加分。没有秘密比赛。没有那种东西。

lines.en: : Just good ole’ fashioned one-on-one fights for our teacher’s body!
lines.zh: : 就只是老派的、为了我们老师的身体而进行的一对一较量！

lines.en: : Yes, how incredibly “ole’ fashioned.”
lines.zh: : 是啊，真是相当“老派”。

lines.en: scene warsend8
: Ladies and gentlemen...the results of the first ever Super Mega Ultimate Dorm War are in.
lines.zh: : 女士们先生们……第一届超级无敌究极宿舍大战的结果已经出炉。

lines.en: : And the winners of the event are...
lines.zh: : 而本次活动的获胜者是……

lines.en: : Wait.
lines.zh: : 等等。

lines.en: : What am I waitin’ for, Makoto?
lines.zh: : 我等什么，Makoto？

lines.en: : Can I do it?
lines.zh: : 能让我来宣布吗？

lines.en: : Forreal? We really doin’ this right now?
lines.zh: : 真的假的？我们真的要在这时候来这套？

lines.en: : Perhaps just let the captain of the winning team announce the results?
lines.zh: : 不如就让获胜队伍的队长来宣布结果？

lines.en: : Yeah, that seems fair to me.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我觉得这样挺公平的。

lines.en: : Agreed! Let the winning team do the talkin’! They worked for it!
lines.zh: : 同意！让获胜的队伍来说！那是她们赢来的！

lines.en: : Then...
lines.zh: : 那么……

lines.en: : In that case...
lines.zh: : 既然如此……

lines.en: if dorm1warpoints > dorm2warpoints:
scene warsend9
$ dormwarfloor1win = True
: The winning team is the first floor!
lines.zh: : 获胜的队伍是一楼！

lines.en: : You fought a good fight, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 你们打得不错，Makoto。

lines.en: : Really showed us second floor girls that we’re gonna need to step up our game if we wanna take over the place.
lines.zh: : 真的让我们二楼的女生看到了，想拿下这里我们还得再加把劲。

lines.en: : I’m incredibly humbled to be the captain of such a great team, and I sincerely appreciate how hard all of you fought in order to win this for us.
lines.zh: : 能当这么一支优秀队伍的队长，我感到无比荣幸，也真心感谢你们每一个人为帮我们赢下这场胜利所付出的努力。

lines.en: : Yes, we may have Sensei now. But what matters even more than that is that we have each other. And-
lines.zh: : 是的，我们现在拥有老师了。但比那更重要的是，我们拥有彼此。而且——

lines.en: : Booooooooo! Only a glasses-faced loser would pretend that Sensei isn’t the true prize of this competition!
lines.zh: : 切————！只有戴眼镜的失败者才会装作老师不是这场比赛的真正奖品！

lines.en: scene warsend10
: I...was just trying to give a humble victory speech...
lines.zh: : 我……只是想发表一段谦虚的获胜感言……

lines.en: : But if you want to play it that way...sure, Ami. Let’s rub it in their faces.
lines.zh: : 但你既然要这么玩……行啊，Ami。那我们就往她们脸上抹。

lines.en: scene warsend11
: Take that, Uta! We get Sensei and you don’t! How does it feel, you little bitch?!
lines.zh: : 尝尝这个，Uta！老师归我们，不归你们！感觉如何，你个小婊子？！

lines.en: : Holy heck, Makoto. No need for the friggin’ power trip.
lines.zh: : 我勒个去，Makoto。没必要搞这种权力宣泄吧。

lines.en: : Just take your heckin’ win and go celebrate or somethin’. No need to hurt my feelings.
lines.zh: : 你就乖乖拿着你的胜利去庆祝不就完了。没必要伤我的心。

lines.en: scene warsend12
: I apologize. That was very unprofessional of me.
lines.zh: : 我道歉。那非常不专业。

lines.en: : Floor one girls, please take the rest of the morning to celebrate our hard earned victory.
lines.zh: : 一楼的女孩们，请用今天上午剩下的时间好好庆祝我们辛苦赢来的胜利。

lines.en: : And please do not follow in my footsteps. Be kind to the losing team, for they are only human. And we are a machine.
lines.zh: : 另外请不要学我。对落败的队伍友善一点，因为她们只是人类。而我们是机器。

lines.en: elif dorm2warpoints > dorm1warpoints:
scene warsend13
$ dormwarfloor2win = True
: Floor two wins!
lines.zh: : 二楼获胜！

lines.en: : Woohoo! Good job, girls!
lines.zh: : 喔呼！干得好，姑娘们！

lines.en: : Hah...
: We really should have vetted the competitions a bit better. There were several that clearly favored your floor and-
lines.zh: : 我们真该把比赛项目审查得更严格一点。有好几个明显偏向你们那一层，而且——

lines.en: : Yeah, yeah. Excuses, excuses. Just accept that my girls are better than your girls and call it a day, prez.
lines.zh: : 是是是。借口，都是借口。承认我的人比你的强，今天就到这儿吧，会长。

lines.en: : Everybody! Y’all worked your friggin’ butts off and deserve this more than anybody I’ve ever met!
lines.zh: : 各位！你们真的拼了老命，比我见过的任何人都配得上这个胜利！

lines.en: : I am glad to be called your leader! And I, Uta Ushibori, hereby solemnly swear to be the captain for the second dorm war as well when the time comes!
lines.zh: : 能被称为你们的队长我很荣幸！而我，Uta Ushibori，在此郑重宣誓，来年第二届宿舍大战时我也要继续当队长！

lines.en: scene warsend14
: Wait, we’re doing this again?
lines.zh: : 等等，我们还要再来一次？

lines.en: : Heck yeah we are.
lines.zh: : 当然要啊。

lines.en: : Even if we all wind up in different classes or get our rooms switched or whatever else happens in this[school], we should all agree to meet here this time next year!
lines.zh: : 就算我们将来分到不同班级、或者换了房间、或者这所[school]里发生别的什么变化，我们也该约定好明年这个时候在这里重聚！

lines.en: : Same teams! Same captains!
lines.zh: : 同样的队伍！同样的队长！

lines.en: : And probably the same champions because we’re the best and you’re stupid!
lines.zh: : 而且大概还是同样的冠军，因为我们最棒，而你们很蠢！

lines.en: scene warsend15
: There’s no need to get hostile over it.
lines.zh: : 没必要为这个敌视起来吧。

lines.en: : Besides, winning Sensei’s company for the night in a room packed to the brim with girls is the equivalent of letting a hungry coyote roam free in a chicken coop.
lines.zh: : 再说了，让老师在挤满女孩的房间里陪我们过一夜，跟放一只饿肚子的土狼在鸡舍里自由活动是一个道理。

lines.en: : I see no problem with this! Let that coyote roam! Let him roam all over me!
lines.zh: : 我觉得这完全没问题！让那只土狼撒欢吧！让它撒遍我全身！

lines.en: : AAAAAAAAAAAHHHH!!!!!!!!!!!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！！！！！！！

lines.en: : You see, Makoto...we all know the dangers of letting Sensei stay in the room with us. And yet we fought for him anyway.
lines.zh: : 你看，Makoto……我们都清楚让老师和我们待在一个房间里有多危险。可我们还是为他拼了。

lines.en: : Why do you think that is?
lines.zh: : 你觉得这是为什么？

lines.en: : Because you’re a bunch of impure lunatics?
lines.zh: : 因为你们是一群不纯洁的疯子？

lines.en: : Because {i}we{/i} like him more than you guys. So ha.
lines.zh: : 因为{i}我们{/i}比你们更喜欢他。所以，怎样。

lines.en: : I can guarantee you that is absolutely not the-
lines.zh: : 我可以向你保证，绝对不是——

lines.en: : Results beg to differ, Makoto. So why don’t you go take a hike or start practicin’ for next year or something?
lines.zh: : 结果说明一切，Makoto。所以你要不要去散个步，或者开始为明年练练什么的？

lines.en: : You're obviously gonna need it.
lines.zh: : 你显然很需要。

lines.en: : You’ll regret this, {i}Uta...{/i}
lines.zh: : 你会后悔的，{i}Uta……{/i}

lines.en: : We’ll see about that, {i}Makoto...{/i}
lines.zh: : 那就走着瞧吧，{i}Makoto……{/i}

lines.en: elif dorm1warpoints == dorm2warpoints:
scene warsend16
$ dormwartie = True
: Both teams win!
lines.zh: : 两支队伍都获胜！

lines.en: scene warsend17

lines.zh: : 那么……

lines.en: : What now?
lines.zh: : 现在怎么办？

lines.en: : The heck are we gonna do to solve this?!
lines.zh: : 这该死的要怎么解决？！

lines.en: : You sayin' we have to do the whole dorm war over?!
lines.zh: : 你是说我们要把整个宿舍大战重来一遍？！

lines.en: : Are we...all sleeping in the same room now?
lines.zh: : 我们现在……都要睡在同一个房间里了吗？

lines.en: : Twenty girls and one man in the same room seems-
lines.zh: : 二十个女孩和一个男人在同一个房间里，这似乎——

lines.en: : Fun? Agreed.
lines.zh: : 很有趣？同意。

lines.en: scene warsend8
: Makoto and I will both admit that we never saw this coming!
lines.zh: : 我和 Makoto 都承认，我们从没料到会这样！

lines.en: : I mean, it was an obvious possibility given that we had ten separate contests...so I wouldn’t say that I believed it was {i}impossible.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我是说，既然我们打了十场单独的比赛，这显然是一种可能……所以我不会说我曾经认为它{i}不可能{/i}。

lines.en: : Blah blah blah math stuff.
lines.zh: : 吧啦吧啦吧啦数学什么的。

lines.en: : Point is, we’re gonna have to have some sort of tiebreaker.
lines.zh: : 重点是，我们得搞个决胜局。

lines.en: : So Makoto and I are gonna arm wrestle and-
lines.zh: : 所以我和 Makoto 准备掰手腕，然后——

lines.en: : We are not.
lines.zh: : 我们不。

lines.en: scene warsend18
: We’re probably just going to have Sensei personally choose the team that he believed performed the best overall.
lines.zh: : 我们大概会让老师亲自选出他认为整体表现最好的队伍。

lines.en: : You sure? Cause I think the arm wrestling thing is a lot more exciting.
lines.zh: : 你确定？因为我觉得掰手腕那招刺激多了。

lines.en: : I mean...what else would you suggest we do? Have another competition that would only exist as the result of a tie?
lines.zh: : 我是说……你还能建议我们怎么办？再办一场只有在平局时才会存在的比赛？

lines.en: scene warsend19
: Absolutely not!
lines.zh: : 绝对不行！

lines.en: : If you lock an entirely new event behind such a specific set of circumstances, there are going to be thousands of entitled players who will complain about it!
lines.zh: : 如果你把一个全新的活动锁在这么特定的条件后面，会有成千上万自认理所应当的玩家跑来抱怨！

lines.en: : It is our job as visual novel heroines to prevent this from happening at all costs because God forbid anyone misses one friggin’ scene in a game longer than life itself!
lines.zh: : 作为视觉小说的女主角，我们的职责就是不惜一切代价阻止这种事发生，因为老天爷可不允许有人错过一款比命还长的游戏里的哪怕一场戏！

lines.en: : But Molly, by that logic, wouldn’t even this outburst of yours constitute such a thing?
lines.zh: : 可是 Molly，按你这个逻辑，你自己这段爆发不也算那种东西吗？

lines.en: : Surely there are dimensions out there where we didn’t tie and this conversation never even happened.
lines.zh: : 肯定存在某些次元，我们没有打平，这段对话根本就不会发生。

lines.en: : Of course! And there are hundreds of other examples of our dialogue changing as a result of our actions as well, and no one complains about them because they feel natural and are not advertised!
lines.zh: : 当然！还有几百个别的例子，我们的对话也会因为自身的行为而改变，可没人抱怨，因为它们感觉自然，而且没有被大肆宣传！

lines.en: : It’s almost like some developers factor in replayability or player influence into their products when what we {i}really{/i} want is a streamlined experience that feels bland, impersonal, and fragmented!
lines.zh: : 就好像有些开发者会把可重玩性或者玩家影响力算进产品里似的，可我们{i}真正{/i}想要的，是一种平淡、没有人情味又支离破碎的流水线体验！

lines.en: : Um...may I...weigh in?
lines.zh: : 嗯……我……可以发表一下看法吗？

lines.en: : Of course, Sana. Feel free. This is an open forum after all.
lines.zh: : 当然可以，Sana。请说。毕竟这是个公开论坛。

lines.en: : I...I think that...players should just accept that...visual novels are meant to be...personal experiences where...where decisions feel important...
lines.zh: : 我……我觉得……玩家应该接受……视觉小说本来就是……让人觉得自己的选择很重要的个人体验……

lines.en: : And...and I wouldn’t really care about...things happening differently because...because it just means I made them that way...
lines.zh: : 而且……而且我不会真的在意……事情发展得不一样，因为……因为那只是意味着是我让它们变成那样的……

lines.en: : But, Sana! What about the {i}completionists?!{/i}
lines.zh: : 可是，Sana！那些{i}完美主义者{/i}怎么办？！

lines.en: : Are you suggesting that we upset a very small demographic of overly vocal players because we want things to make {i}sense?{/i} That is absurd!
lines.zh: : 你是说，我们要为了{i}讲得通{/i}，就去得罪一小撮声音特别大的玩家吗？这太荒谬了！

lines.en: scene warsend20
: How about we just all agree that anyone immature enough to complain about such a thing should be focusing on improving themselves rather than crying about a video game?
lines.zh: : 不如我们就一致同意，任何幼稚到会为这种事抱怨的人，都该把精力放在提升自己上，而不是为一款电子游戏哭天抢地？

lines.en: : Well said, Uta. It’s not like the majority of those players are contributing to the game’s development anyway.
lines.zh: : 说得对，Uta。反正那些玩家大多数也没为游戏的开发出过力。

lines.en: : Right! So they should just trust in the creator! Because if anyone knows what a game is supposed to be, it’s the person making it.
lines.zh: : 没错！所以他们就该信任创作者！因为如果说谁最清楚一款游戏应该是什么样，那就是做游戏的人。

lines.en: : Agreed on all counts.
lines.zh: : 全部同意。

lines.en: scene warsend21
: So fuck you if you are that person!
lines.zh: : 所以如果你就是那种人，去你的！

lines.en: : Yeah. Now go get a real girlfriend or something and stop getting so offended when cartoon girls don’t do exactly what you want them to do.
lines.zh: : 就是。去交个真正的女朋友什么的吧，别再因为卡通女孩没有完全按你的意思做就觉得被冒犯了。

lines.en: : Yeah, nerd!
lines.zh: : 就是，书呆子！

lines.en: : Uta, do you know what I just realized?
lines.zh: : Uta，你知道我刚想到什么吗？

lines.en: : What’s that, Makoto?
lines.zh: : 想到什么，Makoto？

lines.en: : That somewhere out there, there’s going to be someone who has no idea what we’re talking about feeling very confused right now.
lines.zh: : 在某个地方，肯定有个完全不知道我们在说什么的人，此刻正一头雾水。

lines.en: : Oh, jeez. You’re right. They’re probably just tryin’ to get on with their day and choose a winner or something and we’re gettin’ all preachy!
lines.zh: : 哎呀，天哪。你说得对。人家大概只是想赶紧过完这一天、选个赢家什么的，我们却在这儿说教起来了！

lines.en: : True. But chances are they pirated the game anyway so they can fuck right off.
lines.zh: : 确实。不过他们多半也是玩盗版的，所以爱滚多远滚多远。

lines.en: : Did someone say pirate?
lines.zh: : 谁说海盗了？

lines.en: : Oh well. It is what it is, I suppose.
lines.zh: : 唉，算了。该怎样就怎样吧。

lines.en: : The fact is that it’s never possible to please everyone, so you should follow your heart and do what you think is best, even if you know it’s going to make some people mad.
lines.zh: : 事实是，永远不可能取悦所有人，所以你应该跟随自己的心，做你认为最好的选择，哪怕你知道那会让一些人生气。

lines.en: : Unless that decision involves literally hurting people, which is something you should never do!
lines.zh: : 除非那个决定会真正伤害到别人，那种事是绝对不能做的！

lines.en: : That’s right.
lines.zh: : 没错。

lines.en: : Be kind, drive responsibly, stay hydrated, and all of that other positive advice people normally give out to rid themselves of responsibility for the actions of those who can not think for themselves.
lines.zh: : 与人为善、安全驾驶、多喝水，以及人们平时为了甩掉对那些不会自己思考的人的行为所负的责任而给出的其他一切正面建议。

lines.en: : Amen!
lines.zh: : 阿门！

lines.en: : Amen.
lines.zh: : 阿门。

lines.en: scene warsend17
: Okay, but...who wins?
lines.zh: : 好吧，可是……到底谁赢了？

lines.en: : I guess we’ll find out when the time comes to sleep over at the beach!
lines.zh: : 我想等到去海边过夜的时候就知道了！

lines.en: : For now, though...let’s just all be happy that we’re together. And that we’re all winners in at least that respect.
lines.zh: : 不过现在……就让我们为还能在一起而高兴吧。至少在这一点上，我们都是赢家。

lines.en: : Right!
lines.zh: : 没错！

lines.en: : Except for Molly!
lines.zh: : 除了 Molly！

lines.en: : STOP DOING THAT, DAMN IT!
lines.zh: : 别再这样了，该死！

lines.en: scene black
I catch up with the girls shortly after the winning floor is announced and breathe a sigh of relief knowing that this has finally come to an end.
lines.zh: 公布获胜楼层后不久，我追上了女孩们，得知这一切终于画上了句号，我松了一口气。

lines.en: Don’t get me wrong, it’s great watching a bunch of cute girls fight over you, but it’s {i}not{/i} great not having any time to myself to actually...act as I please and whatnot.
lines.zh: 别误会，看着一群可爱的女孩为自己争风吃醋是很爽，但一点属于自己的时间都没有、没法真的……随心所欲什么的，就{i}很糟糕{/i}了。

lines.en: I suppose that doesn’t matter right now, though.
lines.zh: 不过，眼下这些都不重要。

lines.en: I still have the rest of Monday off to do whatever I want and...
lines.zh: 我还有周一剩下的时间可以想干什么就干什么，而且……

lines.en: And I guess that means I’ll just...kick things off with more of the same.
lines.zh: 而且我想那意味着我就要……用更多的同类事情来开场。

lines.en: if chikalust15 == True:
scene warsend22
: Good...morning...Sensei...
lines.zh: : 早……早上好……老师……

lines.en: : Guh...
: Good morning, you two.
lines.zh: : 早上好，你们俩。

lines.en: : How are you feeling?
lines.zh: : 感觉怎么样？

lines.en: : My head...feels like it’s going to explode...
lines.zh: : 我的头……感觉要炸了……

lines.en: : Chika...if it’s not a bother...could you please quiet down?
lines.zh: : Chika……如果不麻烦的话……能请你安静一点吗？

lines.en: : So...just out of my own curiosity...do either of you two remember what happened last night?
lines.zh: : 那么……纯粹出于我自己的好奇……你们俩有谁记得昨晚发生了什么吗？

lines.en: : I...remember...drinking a lot at the bar and...
lines.zh: : 我……记得……在酒吧喝了很多，然后……

lines.en: : And everything after that is just...
lines.zh: : 然后之后的一切就都……

lines.en: : I...drank last night?...
lines.zh: : 我……昨晚喝酒了？……

lines.en: : Wait...yes...yes, I do remember that...
lines.zh: : 等等……对……对，我想起来了……

lines.en: : We didn’t...do anything stupid, did we?...
lines.zh: : 我们没……做什么蠢事吧？……

lines.en: : Nope. Nothing at all. You two made it back to the hotel and then safely went to sleep without doing anything else afterward.
lines.zh: : 没有。完全没有。你们俩平安回到了酒店，然后就乖乖睡了，之后什么都没做。

lines.en: : Okay, but...that doesn’t really explain why we were both...hugging Nodoka when we woke up.
lines.zh: : 好吧，可是……这解释不了我们醒来的时候为什么都……抱着 Nodoka。

lines.en: : She is a lovable girl. I’m sure you just...naturally gravitated to her.
lines.zh: : 她是个招人疼的女孩。我猜你们只是……自然而然被吸引过去了。

lines.en: : I...I don’t think...I should consume alcohol anymore...
lines.zh: : 我……我觉得……我以后不该再喝酒了……

lines.en: : Does...does it always feel like this afterward?...
lines.zh: : 事后……总是这么难受吗？……

lines.en: : Only if you do it correctly.
lines.zh: : 只有喝到位了才会。

lines.en: : I’ll leave you two alone, though. You clearly don't need to be bothered right now.
lines.zh: : 不过我就不打扰你们俩了。显然现在不该来烦你们。

lines.en: : Okay...thanks...
: I think...I’m just gonna go home and sleep anyway...
lines.zh: : 我想……我还是直接回家睡觉算了……

lines.en: : And I...
lines.zh: : 而我……

lines.en: : I think I...need to go to the doctor...
lines.zh: : 我觉得我……得去看医生……

lines.en: scene black
I walk away from two incredibly hungover girls who, thankfully, seem to have zero recollection of their actions last night.
lines.zh: 我离开了两个宿醉到不行的女孩，谢天谢地，她们似乎对昨晚的行为毫无记忆。

lines.en: I’m pretty sure Chika {i}probably{/i} would have been okay with it, but...
lines.zh: 我挺确定 Chika 要是知道了{i}大概{/i}无所谓，不过……

lines.en: I feel like Touka wouldn't have been able to even look at me if she knew how “improper” her actions were last night.
lines.zh: 我觉得 Touka 要是知道自己昨晚的举动有多“不得体”，大概连看都不敢看我。

lines.en: Fortunately, our relationship survives another day and I find myself heading over to a frozen fountain to speak to someone who clearly doesn’t want to be here...
lines.zh: 幸运的是，我们的关系又撑过了一天，而我走向一座结冰的喷泉，去找一个显然并不想待在这里的人说话……

lines.en: scene warsend23
: Morning, Io.
lines.zh: : 早上好，Io。

lines.en: : Morning, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 早上好，老师。

lines.en: if dormwarfloor2win == True:
: My team won, in case you were wondering.
lines.zh: : 我的队伍赢了，如果你想知道的话。

lines.en: : No thanks to me, obviously.
lines.zh: : 显然跟我没什么关系。

lines.en: : Doesn’t really matter if you were involved as long as you won.
lines.zh: : 只要你赢了，参不参与其实无所谓。

lines.en: : Looks like we’ll be staying in the same room for the beach trip, I guess.
lines.zh: : 看来海边旅行我们得住同一个房间了。

lines.en: : I’m probably not going to go. It doesn’t really sound like my sort of thing.
lines.zh: : 我大概不会去。听起来不太像我会喜欢的事。

lines.en: : Oh.
: Well, yeah. I guess that makes sense, then.
lines.zh: : 嗯，是啊。那我想也说得通。

lines.en: : Maybe we can do something on our own soon, then?
lines.zh: : 那我们改天单独做点什么？

lines.en: scene warsend24
: Just us? You’re not inviting your girlfriend?
lines.zh: : 就我们俩？你不邀请你女朋友？

lines.en: : Io-
lines.zh: : Io——

lines.en: scene warsend25
: I’m joking, sorry.
lines.zh: : 我开玩笑的，抱歉。

lines.en: : Yeah...I’d be really happy to see you more, if that’s okay with you.
lines.zh: : 嗯……如果能多见见你，我会很开心，如果你不介意的话。

lines.en: : And...sorry for sneaking in again. I wasn’t really thinking of how much trouble that could cause you when I did it.
lines.zh: : 还有……抱歉我又偷偷溜进去了。我做那件事的时候，真的没想过会给你惹多大麻烦。

lines.en: : I swear to never tell another hotel employee that you’re my father ever again.
lines.zh: : 我发誓，再也不会跟旅馆员工说你是我爸爸了。

lines.en: : Thank you for making such a strange and specific promise to me. I really appreciate it.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你对我许下这么奇怪又具体的承诺。我真的非常感激。

lines.en: elif dormwarfloor1win == True or dormwartie == True:
: My floor lost, in case you were wondering.
lines.zh: : 我这一层输了，如果你想知道的话。

lines.en: : Also, looks like Yuki’s daughter was able to “cooperate” before I was.
lines.zh: : 另外，看来 Yuki 的女儿比我先“配合”上了。

lines.en: : No surprise there, of course.
lines.zh: : 当然，这完全不意外。

lines.en: : You should have come to the bar last night. It was...
lines.zh: : 你昨晚该来酒吧的。那里……

lines.en: : Well, I don’t want to say {i}fun.{/i} But it was certainly interesting.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我不想说{i}好玩{/i}。但确实很有意思。

lines.en: scene warsend25
: I can’t even function around girls in[school]. You really think I’d be better in a party setting where they’re all trying to talk to me and get me to “come out of my shell?”
lines.zh: : 我在[school]里连跟女生正常相处都做不到。你真觉得在一群人都想跟我说话、想让我“走出壳子”的派对场合，我会表现更好？

lines.en: : No. But I would have accepted if you wanted to follow me around and cling to my sleeve or something.
lines.zh: : 不会。不过要是你想跟在我后面、拽着我的袖子什么的，我会答应的。

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m sure your “girlfriend” would have loved that.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我猜你的“女朋友”一定会很乐意。

lines.en: : Io-
lines.zh: : Io——

lines.en: : A joke, obviously.
lines.zh: : 开玩笑的，显然。

lines.en: : Though, I do think you should probably hurry up and toss her aside or she’ll just wind up going crazy and stalking you when you finally {i}do{/i} break up.
lines.zh: : 不过，我{i}真的{/i}觉得你最好赶紧把她甩了，不然等你最后真分手的时候，她会发疯然后跟踪你。

lines.en: : She’s actually a really nice girl, Io.
lines.zh: : 她其实是个很好的女孩，Io。

lines.en: : And I’m not?
lines.zh: : 那我就不是了？

lines.en: : Sure. You’re nice too.
lines.zh: : 当然。你也很好。

lines.en: : Well now you’re just lying to me. We all know that isn’t true.
lines.zh: : 得了吧，你现在是在对我撒谎。我们都知道那不是真的。

lines.en: : Okay, fine. You’re not nice to other girls. But you’re nice to me and that’s pretty much all that matters in my book.
lines.zh: : 好吧，行。你对别的女孩不好。但你对我好，而在我这儿，这基本就是唯一重要的事。

lines.en: : Unless I start belittling them and you have to scold me for it.
lines.zh: : 除非我开始贬低她们，然后你不得不为此训我。

lines.en: : You’re really striking out this morning, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 你今天早上真是连连失手啊，老师。

lines.en: scene warsend26
: Io! Are you finally going to stop avoiding me now that the dorm war is over?!
lines.zh: : Io！宿舍大战都结束了，你总算不躲我了吧？！

lines.en: : Yes. I am finally going to stop avoiding you now that the dorm war is over.
lines.zh: : 是的。宿舍大战结束了，我总算不躲你了。

lines.en: : Did you have fun?
lines.zh: : 你玩得开心吗？

lines.en: : I had a lot of fun! But I would have had {i}more{/i} fun if you were there!
lines.zh: : 我玩得非常开心！不过你要是在的话，我会{i}更{/i}开心！

lines.en: : I {i}was{/i} there. I just wasn’t really doing anything.
lines.zh: : 我在啊。我只{i}是{/i}没怎么做事而已。

lines.en: scene warsend27
: That’s exactly the problem...
lines.zh: : 问题就在这里……

lines.en: : I wanted to do something fun with you...
lines.zh: : 我想跟你一起做点好玩的事……

lines.en: : Then let’s do something fun now.
lines.zh: : 那现在就做点好玩的事吧。

lines.en: : My aunt is working today, so I don’t have to hang out at the bathhouse.
lines.zh: : 我姑姑今天上班，所以我不必待在澡堂里。

lines.en: : I’m also really hungry, soooooo...
lines.zh: : 而且我真的很饿，所以嘛……

lines.en: scene warsend28
: Maybe Sensei might want to come with us and finally get breakfast with me?
lines.zh: : 也许老师想跟我们一起去，终于跟我吃顿早餐？

lines.en: : You’re not going to drag me to an amusement park afterward, are you?
lines.zh: : 你不会吃完之后把我拖去游乐园吧？

lines.en: : I’m not tall enough to ride most of the rides, but I can hold your stuff and watch if you guys want to go on the adult ones.
lines.zh: : 大部分项目我都还不够高，不过要是你们想玩大人玩的那些，我可以帮你们拿东西、在旁边看着。

lines.en: : We’re not going to the amusement park, Uta.
lines.zh: : 我们不去游乐园，Uta。

lines.en: : Sensei hates rollercoasters.
lines.zh: : 老师讨厌过山车。

lines.en: : I like food, though. So, sure. I’ll come get breakfast with you.
lines.zh: : 不过我喜欢吃东西。所以，行。我去跟你们吃早餐。

lines.en: : After that, I’m going back home to take a nap, though.
lines.zh: : 不过吃完我就回家睡个午觉。

lines.en: : It’s surprisingly draining having to judge a series of strange [high_school] competitions.
lines.zh: : 当一堆稀奇古怪的[high_school]比赛的评委，意外地很耗神。

lines.en: : You’re really starting to sound old, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 你听起来真是越来越老了，老师。

lines.en: : Come on, grandpa. It’s time for your chemo.
lines.zh: : 来吧，爷爷。该去做化疗了。

lines.en: : Uta, please stop saying things like that...
lines.zh: : Uta，别再说这种话了……

lines.en: scene black
We manage to slip away from the gathering without anyone else seeing us and head over to some random diner none of us had been to before.
lines.zh: 我们趁没人看见溜出了聚会，去了一家我们三人都没去过的路边餐馆。

lines.en: Everything there was exceedingly average, but it was still an enjoyable outing regardless.
lines.zh: 那里的一切都平淡得出奇，但不管怎么说，这趟出门依然很愉快。

lines.en: Sure, Uta talked way more than anyone should ever talk...but it complemented the type of person both Io and myself are.
lines.zh: 没错，Uta 说的话比任何人该说的都多得多……但这恰好和 Io 还有我这种人互补。

lines.en: And weirdly enough, all of it felt completely natural.
lines.zh: 而且奇怪的是，这一切都感觉无比自然。

lines.en: The two of them make a strange combo, but the fact that they’re able to get over things like Io constantly disappearing and avoiding Uta as if it’s routine really shows a lot about their friendship.
lines.zh: 她们俩是个奇怪的组合，但她们居然能把 Io 不停消失、以及像例行公事一样躲着 Uta 这种事都跨过去，这很能说明她们的友情。

lines.en: Or what I imagine their friendship to be.
lines.zh: 或者说，我想象中她们的友情。

lines.en: I’m sure things are a lot more complicated than that.
lines.zh: 我肯定实际情况比这复杂得多。

lines.en: But I guess that’s something I’ll learn in time.
lines.zh: 不过我想，那是我迟早会了解到的东西。

lines.en: For now-
lines.zh: 至于现在——

lines.en: I’m just glad I can finally relax.
lines.zh: 我只是很高兴自己终于可以放松了。

lines.en: scene bedroom_noon
I walk into the bedroom and instinctively search for the air conditioner I’d grown used to over the last two nights.
lines.zh: 我走进卧室，下意识地去找过去两晚已经习惯的那台空调。

lines.en: It’s not there.
lines.zh: 它不在了。

lines.en: scene black
I go to sleep warm.
lines.zh: 我在燥热中睡去。

lines.en: {i}Congratulations on completing the first ever Super Mega Ultimate Dorm War!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}恭喜你完成了第一届超级无敌究极宿舍大战！{/i}

lines.en: {i}As soon as you wake up, everything will go back to normal and you’ll be able to act on your own again.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}等你一觉醒来，一切都会恢复正常，你又能按自己的意愿行动了。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Thank you for surrendering two days of your seemingly infinite time in Kumon-mi.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}谢谢你交出在 Kumon-mi 那看似无限的时光中的两天。{/i}

lines.en: $ dormwar17 = True
I wake up just as the sun begins to set.
lines.zh: 我在太阳开始西沉时醒来。

lines.en: What do I want to do with the rest of my day?
lines.zh: 今天剩下的时间，我想做点什么呢？

lines.en: jump asmenu
